payload.body: You tend to choose rest and then feel trapped by the quiet, or choose connection and resent how much energy it requires. The routine keeps changing because meeting one need does not settle the other. This often comes from treating comfort as the responsible choice and desire as the disruptive one. Plan for both needs instead of making either choice prove what you really want.
payload.astroHint: Lilith quincunx the Moon can make comfort and desire ask for different things at the same time.
